needs_human.note: App-wide provider hydration no longer remounts the page subtree (Sidebar, Theme and Profile providers). Neither the spec nor its invariants describe this.; SlotEntryRenderer's onRendered signal is a new pending state for addon entries. Revised I1 states the rule for player-side, but the shared component now carries it for any caller that passes onRendered.
The app-wide provider changes (Sidebar/Theme/Profile) change hydration behaviour for every page, not only the file detail page.
